nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build for the PaddleOCR/RapidOCR microservice: installs OpenCV/ONNXRuntime system libraries and Python dependencies, pre-warms the bundled PP-OCR ONNX models at build time, then serves the FastAPI app via uvicorn on port 8080.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs `python -c "from rapidocr_onnxruntime import RapidOCR; RapidOCR()"` during the build stage specifically to force unpacking/initialization of the bundled ONNX models at build time, avoiding a network download or cold-start delay at container runtime.
